# Legacy Edition Minigames
Legacy Edition Minigames is a work in progress remake of the minigames from Minecraft: Legacy Console edition for Java Edition.

## Gamemodes
- Battle is a Hunger Games style mode with faster pacing, it is currently the only gamemode available.
- Glide is currently being worked on and will begin public testing within a few months.
- Tumble will have work begin once Glide is completed.

## Required mods
You do **not** need a modded client to join, but you may optionally get the [LEM Client Helper mod](https://www.legacyminigames.net/lch) for an enhanced experience.
